title: Monsterwalll's Bosses And Stuff
description: A mod I made that adds Bosses, Structures and more! Note that this is my first mod so please comment what you think should be fixed in future mods.
body:
This is my first mod. I will not be updating or porting to a different version because 1 I don't know how and 2 then it wouldn't truly be my first mod. Please give me suggestions for future mods in the comments because it helps me learn.

BOSSES:

Bill Cipher: If you've ever watched Gravity Falls you already know this one. Not much is needed to defeat him, just Iron gear and some throwing knives will do.
Caine: A classic TADC character, you can find him in the circus. He is the 2nd boss in progression and Iron as well as a Gloink Bazooka is recommended.
Animaniacs: Yakko, Wakko, and Dot. Yakko is the tallest, Wakko has the most health, and Dot does the most damage. Please make total use of the loot at the Water Tower as you will need it. Diamond is best for these.
Tom: The Lizard from Hoppers. Honestly, I had already added a Lizard sound button and felt like I needed to fix the progression a little bit.
Herobrine: A creepypasta legend, he is very strong and you will need netherite as well as all previous weapons.
Notch: Originally planned to be the final boss, he is also VERY strong. Enchanted Netherite, Herobrine's Sword and a Gloink Bazooka as well as a few stacks of gloinks are suggested.
Brotherhood: A combination of Herobrine and Notch, this is as strong as MCreator would let me make him. AXOLOTL armor, weapons and a dragon cannon are required if you want to live.

ITEMS:

Throwing knives: Also known as a Kunai, these are powerful and great at aiming.
Gloink: Ammo for a Gloink Bazooka
Gloink Bazooka: A very powerful Bazooka that fires Gloinks.
Caines Cane: Caines Cane.
Arms: Remember that seen in TADC where Caine grows a bunch of arms and attacks the cast? Yeah that.
Hammer: Dot's Hammer. Very Strong.
Yakko's Overalls: Yakko's Overalls. Very Protective.
Wakko's Hat: Wakko's Hat. Very Protective.
Herobrines Sword: Very, VERY strong. Obtained by killing Herobrine.
God Apple: Gives you Levitation, Health Boost 255, and Regeneration 10 for 2 minutes.
UnGod Apple: Removes the effects of the God Apple.
Dragon Cannon: Fires Dragon Breath, so collect a lot of that while fighting the Ender Dragon. One of the most powerful items I made.
AXOLOTL Armor: Best Armor in the game. Obtained by wishing at the Axolotl.
AXOLOTL Sword: Best Sword in the game. Obtained by wishing at the Axolotl.
AXOLOTL Gun: Best Gun in the Game. Obtained by wishing at the Axolotl.
Computer: If you sell, it gives you an emerald at the price of an item. If you buy, you pay emeralds to get an item.

OTHER ENTITIES:

Herobrine Chicken: Punch it. Do it.
Steve: Just Steve.
Alex: Just Alex.
Zombie: Summoned by Moveset, tamed by grass.
Skeleton: Summoned by Moveset, tamed by grass.
Gloink: Kill, get a gloink.
Hacker: Villager but trades are actualy decent. (By that I mean if you have emeralds you can become god)

REQUIRMENTS:

None but JEI is prefered.
